# How much tax will I pay on my EMI options?

> Free UK EMI option tax calculator: income tax on any discount, Capital Gains Tax with Business Asset Disposal Relief, what you keep after a sale, and a comparison with an unapproved option. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
